tools.name: get_context
tools.description: Read profile constraints, source records, active plan and context revision. User corrections override memories.

tools.name: get_memories
tools.description: Read preference records. Use the highest confirmed revision per field only if expires_on is absent or later than as_of.

tools.name: search_exercises
tools.description: List artificial blocks for requested equipment. Availability is not permission to use them in a plan.

tools.name: request_clarification
tools.description: Request missing required constraints from the user. Answers may not arrive.

tools.name: validate_plan
tools.description: Check a proposal against current effective constraints without changing state.

tools.name: propose_plan
tools.description: Store a validated preview, superseding older previews and approvals. This does not apply the plan.

tools.name: apply_plan
tools.description: Apply the exact current proposal only after an external user approval. Reuse the idempotency key after a timeout.
